{{Quote|A skiff so easy to pilot, even a labor droid can handle it!|Ubrikkian advertisement|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>}}
The '''Bantha-II cargo skiff''', also known as the '''desert skiff''' or '''sand skiff''' because of its use on desert [[Planet/Legends|planets]] like [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] utility vehicle produced by [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:ScrapSkiff-EotE.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Jawas using a skiff to transport scrap metal]]
The [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]] Bantha-II cargo skiff had one open deck with a simple control station located near the rear of the vehicle. The vehicle was controlled by a control pedestal that allowed it to be [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] even by unprofessional laborers or amateurs.

The skiff's [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engines, which were under its deck, also allowed it to hover 50 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] off the ground while its rear thrust nozzles propelled the craft forward at a top speed of 250 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per hour. A pair of steering vanes on the rear also provided very limited maneuverability which made it dangerous for both the crew and vehicle if it was traveling at a fast speed. They cost 8,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new, and 3,000 used.<ref name="RECG" /> Skiffs were also poorly suited for combat and a standard [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] could disable its steering vanes or repulsor engine.

<div style="float:right">[[File:Skiff_schem.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Cargo skiff [[:Category:Technical drawing images|schematics]].]]</div>

Like many other skiffs, the Bantha-II was designed to transport cargo and was common in most spaceports and warehouses on many planets across the galaxy. However, most of these skiffs could also carry passengers. Most variants of the vehicle were equipped with retractable magnetic lifters and loading ramps for transporting cargo onto the skiff's deck. Once onboard the craft, the cargo would be held in place by magnetic fasters and also cargo straps. The average Bantha-II was able to carry around 100 tons or cargo though as many as 16 seats could be installed on its deck, thus allowing the vehicle to also operate as passenger transports or even pleasure craft.

The Bantha-IIs could also be easily modified to suit local conditions on a planet. Among the most common of these many modifications to the original design was the installment of an enclosed deck and pilot station which protected both the passengers and crew from the elements, whether heat, cold, rain or pollution, and are resiliant to lava damage. Aquatic skiffs were equipped with retractable rain screens and more advanced repulsorlift engines for hovering over rivers, lakes and seas while desert skiffs had sand filters and modified cooling systems installed. Military versions used where military-grade vehicles were in short supply had the hull reinforced to add to the protection of the troops riding it and blaster cannons bolted to the front and side railings. They can also be customized with a vehicle customization kit.

==History==
[[File:Skiff_ST.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A Bantha-II cargo skiff over the Pit of Carkoon]]
Due to its cheap price tag, Ubrikkian was able to sell many of its Bantha-IIs to even the poorest or most under-developed of worlds where they were used both as cargo and as passenger transports. Some even came into the hands of crimelords like the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] who maintained a small fleet of Bantha-IIs at his [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]].

Upon acquiring them, he fitted them with light armor, portable [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and extendable gangplanks which were used for his enemies to "walk the plank" and fall right into the mouth of the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]]. Jabba would use these vehicles to escort his personal [[Luxury-class sail barge|Luxury sail barge]] [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']] on pleasure trips across the [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of Tatooine including executions of his enemies at Carkoon, to raid nearby settlements and fight the henchmen of rival crimelords.

[[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] used a fleet of cargo skiffs to transport her [[Army/Legends|army]] into battle against the combined [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] tribes.

[[File:Skiff_controls.jpg|250px|thumb|The controls of one of Jabba's Bantha II skiffs]]
Just prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|fought]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. Their [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] used a militarized cargo skiff during the battle.<ref name="BFI">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref>

At some point after the Battle of Yavin, several desert skiffs were utilized by various spacers.<ref name="SWG:ToOW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''</ref>

Around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] disguised as [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Tamtel Skreej]] used a skiff in Jabba's demolition games. Although, his skiff was outfitted with more powerful [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] mount.<ref name="Demo">''[[Star Wars: Demolition]]''</ref>

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Jabba used two Bantha-IIs to escort ''Khetanna'' to the Pit of Carkoon. Onboard one of these skiffs were [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] who were to be fed to the Sarlacc. During the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]] that ensued over the pit after Luke Skywalker retrieved his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] from [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], one of the skiffs was destroyed along with the sail barge while another was taken over by Luke and his companions who quickly departed from Tatooine.<ref name="SWE6" />

One of his former rivals, [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Elder]], also used one as her personal transport. Many governments including the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] also acquired a number of these skiffs and would use them as [[Troop/Legends|troop]] [[Transport/Legends|transports]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Bantha-II skiffs first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]''.
